prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Verify Your Pet's Desktop Presence", "Let us make sure your pet displays clearly on top of your windows before completing setup.", "Test Desktop Spawn", "Desktop Visibility Check", "Click below to send your pet on a test run across your screen. Can you see it roaming?", "I See My Pet!"]
1: ["Upload High-Quality Photos for Custom Pet", "Our photo analyzer verifies lighting and angles to ensure your generated desktop pet renders accurately.", "Select Clear Photos", "Lighting & Resolution Verified"]
2: ["Master Desktop Companion Controls", "Try the interactive controls below to practice moving, hiding, and interacting with your pet right now.", "Practice Hotkeys & System Tray Controls", "Complete Setup"]
3: ["Your Companion is Being Built", "Explore upcoming pet traits and sound effects while your graphics render in the background.", "Did you know? Double-clicking your pet opens the interaction wheel.", "Building 3D Mesh Assets..."]
4: ["Secure Your Desktop Companion Account", "Sign in to keep your pet synchronized across all your devices without losing progress.", "Signing in connects your pet safely to your profile. Existing pets will never be overwritten."]
5: ["Choose Your Companion Archetype", "Listen to sound cues and preview idle behaviors before officially adopting.", "Preview Sound Cues"]
6: ["Preparing Desktop Overlay", "We are verifying screen compatibility and system tray registration.", "Ensure your system tray icon is enabled if your pet hides behind full-screen apps.", "Checking GPU rendering overlay permissions..."]
7: ["Select Your Onboarding Journey", "Pick direct adoption for quick start or custom pet creation for tailored graphics.", "Quick Preset Adoption vs Custom Pet Generator"]
8: ["Link Account & Transfer Companion", "Choose your primary sign-in method. Your currently created pet will automatically attach to your profile.", "Returning user? Sign in with the exact same method to restore previous pets.", "Automatic Cloud Sync & Restore Active"]
9: ["Welcome to Your Desktop Companion Experience", "Watch your pet react to mouse clicks and desktop activities right from the start.", "Begin Setup"]

verdicts.problem: Asks user to upload photos, which can contain personal information.
